scope: Cold startup to empty Restore and cancel; source-framed storage only. No ordinary gameplay save or restored field yet.

notes: The source stream address 0x0024f6d0 is not file-backed in the ELF; no guest pointer or memory image is serialized.
Only the first zero atlas tuple is imported; consumer 0x0011f7a0 stops at that tuple.
Literal bytes are preserved without conversion; strings use the game byte encoding.
No save format, memory-card service behavior, or callback behavior is implemented by this artifact.
imported_restore.scope: Pointer-free Restore descriptor and referenced static literal bytes; no native save behavior or callback implementation.

source_ranges.meaning: first all-zero 16-byte tuple terminates the atlas list

original.scope: Oracle-only snapshot continuation from original empty Restore2875, fixed declared native1200/source0 component anchor. Not a new cold-start parity claim.

excluded_native_fields.reason: Host storage service is not PS2 asynchronous I/O state.

restore.retirement_interpretation: Absence after the final observation is not itself proof of retirement. Only frames with both last-active dead flags set and a same-frame native manager-present=0/dead=1 record are labeled with observed retirement evidence.

alignment.parent_phase_edges: Source 0x124818 parent entry is before parent update; native game-mode point 0 is sampled in the same update.
alignment.restore_edges: Source value is second_callback_entry before original 0x11c2c8 (after input handler); native value is completed tick state.
alignment.rule: Source frame f maps only to native completed tick f+1200; no anchor fitting or later realignment.
